label: original-phase input of m/r/j/p (esp. mid-sequence)
explanation: Fires mostly (91% of mass) during the original phase, peaking at positions 3-5; strongest on input m (35% of m steps active, 22% of mass; top activations are nearly all m), then r, j, p, and more weakly k, y, a, 0. Magnitude is higher when the sequence began with or contained w/v/s/c/l/n (first_tok w/v ~2.5x lift; top examples all start with w/v/s), and on first occurrences of the token. Weak residual activity in the copy phase when outputting v or w. Almost never fires on the delimiter or at recall_idx 0. Context priming is distributed, so precision stays low (~0.38); predicate F1 ~0.43.
